atmosphere.qualification: Assumed ICAO-like sea-level atmosphere because the publications do not report test conditions.

parameters.uncertaintyQualification: The publications round velocity to whole metres per second and report no measurement or calculation uncertainty. The 1 m/s value is a fitting weight and is not a claimed source standard deviation.
assumptions: The published V1 value of 575 m/s supplies the launch velocity and is excluded from the fitted observations.
The 33 m and 50 m values come from different non-primary publications and are both calibration inputs.
No physically separate holdout observation is available.

method.objective: Minimize the sum of squared velocity residuals divided by the declared fitting-weight variance using calibration-role observations only.
